channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today, October 29: Check fuel rates in different cities across India
item.description: Fuel prices were steady for petrol and diesel across major cities, but CNG became costlier in many locations.&nbsp;

item.title: 'Classified material missing from Epstein files': Report reveals clues, email gaps
item.description: Included among the Epstein files is an eight-page timeline of the FBI's New York office's initial efforts last year to track down and deliver its voluminous files to the Justice Department's Washington headquarters.

item.title: Israel election latest update: Who will form the next government as Netanyahu, Eisenkot fall short?
item.description: With about 90 per cent of votes counted, neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot looks set to win 61 seats. Latest on Arab turnout, coalition talks and what comes next.

item.title: Silver imports surge at India’s bullion exchange after new licensing rules
item.description: The surge follows a May decision by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade to move certain categories of silver to the restricted list, requiring importers to obtain authority's licences.

item.title: Screwworm Detected for First Time in Arizona as Outbreak Spreads
item.description: New World screwworm was found in Arizona for the first time, detected in a dog, as cases of the deadly parasite accelerate.

item.title: Alvin Hellerstein, Judge in Maduro, 9/11 Cases, Dies at 92
item.description: Veteran federal judge Alvin Hellerstein, who oversaw cases against Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, Archegos Capital Management family office founder Bill Hwang and litigation over the 9/11 terrorist attack, died at 92.

item.title: Dhanteras, Diwali tours: Travelling this festive season? Here's how to find cheaper train and flight tickets | Guide
item.description: With airfares on domestic and international routes rising sharply and train tickets selling out quickly, travellers can save by booking early. Here's how to find cheaper fares if you are travelling this festive season.

item.title: No phones, no scrolling: These restaurants are asking parents to put their devices away — Here’s what diners get instead
item.description: The pilot programme seeks to offer families an alternative: putting their devices aside, playing games and using mealtimes to talk to one another.

item.title: US goods trade deficit widens in September as AI boom drives imports to record high
item.description: According to Reuters, US goods trade deficit widened from $2.8 billion to $134.9 billion in September. While imports of goods increase $8.1 billion to $344.1 billion, goods exports climbed from $5.3 billion to $209.2 billion.

item.title: MEA confirms 22 Indian nationals killed amid West Asia conflict: 'We remain deeply concerned about the situation'
item.description: MEA official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal expressed serious concern over the worsening security situation in the region during the ministry's bi-weekly media briefing.

item.title: Why is Mihirkant Upadhyaya pursuing an MBA despite having 3 Degrees, a PhD and years of experience at Intel?
item.description: With graduation expected in June 2027, Upadhyaya is continuing to combine an established career in semiconductor manufacturing with another academic qualification — this time focused not on the science behind technology, but on the business and operational systems that help bring it to market.

item.title: Pakistan reverses Taiwan airspace ban: How the ban would have changed global airspace and impacted air traffic
item.description: Pakistan reversed its reported ban on Taiwanese airlines using its airspace, granting China Airlines and EVA Airways permission to operate from October 28, 2026, to March 27, 2027. The initial restriction was attributed to Pakistan’s One China policy and had prompted flights to reroute.

item.title: Cancer surgery from 35 miles away: How a Florida doctor used a robotic system — But safety questions remain | Details
item.description: The patient was in an operating room at AdventHealth Minneola, while Dr Vipul Patel controlled the surgical instruments remotely from AdventHealth Celebration, located 35 miles away.

item.title: Mumbai airport asks airlines to submit plans by November 3 for shifting international flights to Navi Mumbai
item.description: Mumbai airport operator MIAL has asked airlines to submit plans by November 3 for shifting some international flights to Navi Mumbai airport. Several carriers want more time, with some seeking to defer relocation until October 2027 amid concerns over the transition and terminal redevelopment.

item.title: Textile ministry reopens PLI scheme, halves turnover threshold to ₹100 cr
item.description: The application portal the PLI scheme for textiles will open from 1 November to 31 December.

item.title: ₹2.5 lakh monthly salary in Qatar to a new life in Mysuru: Why this Indian man quit his high-paying job
item.description: Aditya Singh said he left an airline job in Qatar that paid him ₹2.5 lakh a month and moved back to India three years ago. Now married and settled in Mysuru, the transformation coach says his life comes with work challenges but offers a sense of freedom he values.

item.title: Who is Jacinda Ardern? Why former New Zealand PM has been appointed professor at the University of Sydney
item.description: Jacinda Ardern, 43, who retired from politics in January 2023, will take up a Professor of Practice role this month and will deliver guest lectures and masterclasses, as well as provide mentoring.

item.title: Hero, TVS and Bajaj outshine carmakers with record profit growth amid West Asia blues
item.description: Two-wheeler makers continued to outperform carmakers in the September quarter, with TVS Motor and Hero MotoCorp posting strong profit growth driven by exports, domestic demand and resilient margins. Maruti Suzuki and Hyundai Motor India reported profit declines amid profitability pressure.

item.title: A husband built an AI job-search tool for his wife. She landed a job, and he open-sourced - How it happened? All detail
item.description: After his wife spent nearly 10 months looking for a job, a developer built Dossier to automate job discovery, tailored resumes, cover letters and application tracking. The tool has since drawn attention online, with some users praising the idea.

item.title: Mumbai airport system outage: 18 flights delayed, 3 cancelled, DigiYatra affected, here's what authorities said
item.description: IndiGo and Air India were affected by a recent technical glitch at the Mumbai International Airport. All operations were shifted to manual mode.

item.title: BJP fields Hardeep Singh Puri for Rajya Sabha bypoll
item.description: BJP has fielded Hardeep Singh Puri for the Rajya Sabha by-election from Madhya Pradesh, paving the way for his return, as his current term from Uttar Pradesh nears end.

item.title: Flydubai Captain Smit Machchhar gets UAE’s top honour. How his courage earned praise from world leaders
item.description: The honour comes amid widespread international praise for Machchhar, whose actions helped avert a potential aviation disaster.

item.title: She spent ₹200 at Garba event in MP; a year later, her grandson won ₹50 lakh Fortuner his family had long dreamt of
item.description: When Vedansh was declared the winner, the family was left astonished. The coupon, which cost just ₹200, had won them a Toyota Fortuner reportedly valued at approximately ₹50 lakh.

item.title: Bengaluru man pays ₹12,500 monthly for 40 months, gets ₹20,000 from chit fund: Consumer court orders ₹4.08 lakh payout
item.description: A Bengaluru consumer commission has directed Samith Chits Pvt Ltd to pay Vishnuprasad ₹4,07,940 with 6.5% annual interest after the company failed to clear his chit fund prize money. The subscriber had paid ₹12,500 monthly for 40 months and received only ₹20,000 after winning his bid.

item.title: Employees dance, celebrate as Haryana-based company gifts Kia Sonet SUVs to top-performing staff ahead of Diwali | Video
item.description: The initiative aims to recognise employees' strong performance. One of the employees said he had been with the company for five years before being selected for the reward.

item.title: WeWork India bets on demand as premium office supply tightens
item.description: Availability of Grade A offices - premium commercial properties with modern infrastructure - in the country's eight largest cities, including Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Gurgaon, is likely to remain limited over the next two years, Clifford Lobo, chief financial officer of WeWork India, said.

item.title: Dubai's ‘die-hard Apple fan’ has 53 iPhones, from the first model to foldable Duo — What's his next dream?
item.description: Mohammed Shakaa has spent nearly 20 years collecting iPhones, displaying a wide variety of different models and colour variants at home.

item.title: HD Hyundai backs India’s Thoothukudi shipyard plan
item.description: The investment commitment from the Korean shipbuilder was secured during the ongoing four-day visit of shipping minister Sarbananda Sonowal to South Korea.

item.title: Meet Advocate Asmi: 23-year-old becomes first Gen Z member of a State Bar Council in India
item.description: Advocate Asmi, 23, has been elected unopposed to the Bar Council of Punjab and Haryana, becoming the youngest-ever member of a State Bar Council in India and the first Gen Z representative elected to any State Bar Council, according to the announcement.

item.title: Union cabinet clears ₹29,267 crore for container, sports goods manufacturing
item.description: Three new schemes aim to boost domestic manufacturing, create sports goods hubs and strengthen panchayat capacity, while a 3% DA hike will cost the exchequer ₹10,016 crore.

item.title: CCPA directs district officials across India to crack down on misleading coaching ads
item.description: For the first time, district magistrates have been told to conduct inspection drives and enforce ad compliance as coaching hubs expand into smaller towns, targeting IAS and UPSC aspirants.

item.title: Union Cabinet approves ₹10,000 crore container manufacturing scheme to boost capacity tenfold, generate 53,000 jobs
item.description: Cabinet approved container manufacturing promotion scheme which comes with three major components, including Interest Subvention Assistance (ISA), Operational Expenditure Assistance (OEA), and testing and certification assistance. The initiative was announced in the Union Budget 2026-27.

item.title: CDSCO drug alert: Himachal pulls 92 substandard batches, halts 96 pharma units
item.description: State health authorities ask patients to stop using flagged batches as 70 drug samples produced in the state fail critical ingredient tests while 22 show minor defects.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab: Several flights cancelled, trains suspended between October 28 and November 4 | Full list here
item.description: The Railway Department said that passengers are advised to check these updates while planning their journey and can get the latest information on the National on Railways website.

item.title: Israel election results: How is the prime minister chosen, and why doesn't the largest party always win?
item.description: With no clear winner emerging, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and other parties could face weeks of negotiations to form a government.
